target_customer: Robotics teams training and evaluating manipulation policies
problem: Improving robot policies needs many real-world hours for setup, trials and resets; One Robot builds world model simulations from task data to cut that dependence.
business_model: Task-specific world model simulation environments sold to robotics teams

founders.name: Hemanth Sarabu
previous_startups: Crescer AI (bootstrapped to profitability, per YC page)
founders.background_notes: Launch post says he built vehicle simulations at McLaren.

founders.name: Elton Shon
prior_employers: Tesla (five years, robotics and AI infrastructure)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he worked on the Model 3 ramp and the Dojo supercomputer team.

competitors.name: Runway (GWM-Robotics)
competitors.what: General world model for robotics used to evaluate policies without hardware
competitors.traction_then: Evaluated eight policies against real-world ground truth, February 2026 post

technical_complexity.rationale: Learning contact dynamics and deformable objects in a world model that correlates with real robot success is research-grade.

defensibility.rationale: Customer task data could compound, but large labs and funded startups work on the same capability.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: A July 2026 post cited on CB Insights says larger players shipped versions that work on real manipulation tasks.

market_need_then: The YC page says VLA improvement is bottlenecked by slow, costly real-world trials in material handling and assembly.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name with little brand press found; a startup profile exists but nothing on the brand.

outcome_analysis: One Robot is a Winter 2026 YC company with no outcome yet. Founders from Tesla, Google and Industrial Next fit the robotics domain, but the problem is research-grade and large players have shipped similar world models, so durability is uncertain.
notes: Aggregators report $500K via convertible note (CB Insights, Employbl); investor lists conflict (YC, Accel, Toloka.vc, Sequoia logos). Company careers page claims Accel backing but no round with a date and amount was found, so not recorded as a round. Founder education not found.
